Resolves #18612
Refs #18605

The Workstation declares its shipped arrangement and reads the engine's committed truth instead of deriving its own. `perspectives: {shipped: initialDocument}` rides #18641's document-valued declaration while `construct` keeps supplying the saved main, so a torn-out pane stays owned by its vessel. The topology bar's Reset and state line bind `dock.perspective.modified`, and `readTopologyState` keeps only the window count: its `TopologyDiff` comparison was a second predicate over the same pair, blind to pin state ([measured](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18612#issuecomment-5649270420), [decided (A)](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18612#issuecomment-5652449225)). `captureTopology` stamps a record's origin from the accepted-write identity, both libraries refuse the shipped name, and the cold-hydrate write adopts a known-origin snapshot's name.

Evidence: L3 achieved for AC-6 (a real popup under the Neural Link fixture with the external Brain runtime, run locally — that tier does not run in CI) and L2 for AC-1–AC-5 (unit tier: constructed Workstation hosts, real Group commits, published provider leaves) → L3 required for AC-6. Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket
- The baseline is the document-valued declaration from #18641. The ticket's first `$default` prescription is refused by the single-owner check under a saved topology with a pane outside main ([intake measurement](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18612#issuecomment-5649118534)); the slice section, AC-1 and AC-5 were amended to match.
- AC-6's "each pane in exactly one workspace" holds by refusal: under a Group the engine refuses a declared restore that would duplicate a pane a sibling holds (`DockPerspectiveSelection.spec.mjs`, F11), so the rendered arm pins that refusal across a real window boundary. Giving torn-out panes back stays the Workstation Reset's job.
- The readout spec's departure arms (split, move, rail drag, return) go with the predicate; `DockPerspectiveState.spec.mjs` pins those facts for `PerspectiveState.isModified`.

- Review coverage note, dispositioned without a ticket. The cold-hydrate unit arms assemble the write instead of invoking `createRoot`. A with/without probe at 285f642a69 shows that the origin change `createRoot` adds leaves `dock.perspective`, `perspectiveProvenance()` and a later capture's `declaredPerspective` identical while `shipped` is the only declared perspective, so an arm could only spy on the write's composition. Revalidate when the Workstation declares a second perspective.
- Review `[TOOLING_GAP]`, no ticket: the cancelled `check-size` run was superseded at the same head, and `gh pr checks` and the readiness projection already read its replacement.
